## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case
Describe a specific use case where this feature would be helpful.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Willingness to Contribute
- [ ] I would be willing to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] I would be willing to help test this feature
- [ ] I'm just suggesting this for consideration
